name: David Fowler Johnson
tagline: Top rated Estate & Trust Litigation attorney in Fort Worth, Texas
about: David Fowler Johnson is an attorney who represents clients in the Fort Worth, Texas area. David Johnson is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

David Johnson chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Baylor University School of Law and graduated in 1997. David Johnson passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1997.
He represents clients with Estate & Trust Litigation issues in Texas. He also represents clients with Business Litigation issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, David Johnson has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
300 Throckmorton Street Suite 1700 Fort Worth, TX 76102
